mono-0001.d: Brutalist facade grid of tight bays, heavily filled in. Concrete energy without the weight.

mono-0004.d: Radial halftone burst on a medium screen. Light and shade without a single grey.

mono-0010.d: Several families of sine waves crossing into a moiré. Contour-map calm.

mono-0014.d: Dot-matrix bars on a chunky LED grid. The dots are the point.

mono-0016.d: Cantilevered stack of concrete slabs, a few poured solid. Measured, rhythmic, a little severe.

mono-0024.d: Radial halftone burst on a medium screen. Grey made entirely of dots, the way presses do it.

mono-0029.d: Ordered halftone gradient in stacked bands on a medium screen. The dots are the point.

mono-0034.d: Dot-matrix cross on a chunky LED grid. Looks different up close than from afar.

mono-0036.d: Cantilevered stack of concrete slabs, a few poured solid. Strict lines, softened by cotton.

mono-0044.d: Radial halftone burst on a coarse screen. The dots are the point.

mono-0054.d: Dot-matrix diamond on a chunky LED grid. Vibrates gently when you walk.

mono-0057.d: Truchet tiling of half-square triangles, fine-grained. Shapes doing very little, very well.

mono-0069.d: Ordered halftone gradient in stacked bands on a coarse screen. Vibrates gently when you walk.

mono-0074.d: Dot-matrix circle on a chunky LED grid. Light and shade without a single grey.

mono-0075.d: Topographic contour map with elevation lines packed tight. Somewhere between a map and a sound wave.

mono-0084.d: Radial halftone burst on a coarse screen. Grey made entirely of dots, the way presses do it.

mono-0090.d: Several families of sine waves crossing into a moiré. Pulses gently from a distance.

mono-0092.d: Open concentric squares, twisting slowly inward. Geometry class, but good.

mono-0094.d: Dot-matrix bars on a chunky LED grid. Tonal depth from one ink.
